description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'VacancyDao' for managing 'Vacancy' entities in the Recruitment plugin of OrangeHRM. It provides methods for retrieving, saving, counting, deleting, and verifying vacancies, as well as fetching related data such as vacancy IDs and hiring managers.

classes.name: VacancyDao
classes.description: DAO class for handling database operations related to Vacancy entities within the OrangeHRM Recruitment module.

methods.name: getVacancies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Vacancy entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getVacancyListPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator for a list of vacancies filtered by parameters.

methods.name: getVacanciesQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query with filtering conditions for vacancies based on search parameters.

methods.name: saveJobVacancy
methods.description: Persists a Vacancy entity to the database.

methods.name: getVacanciesCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of vacancies matching the search filter.

methods.name: getVacancyById
methods.description: Retrieves a Vacancy by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingVacancyIds
methods.description: Fetches existing vacancy IDs from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getHiringManagerEmpNumberList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of hiring manager employee numbers based on search filters.

methods.name: getVacancyIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Fetches vacancy IDs associated with a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: isHiringManager
methods.description: Checks if an employee ID corresponds to an active hiring manager.

methods.name: getPublishedVacancyList
methods.description: Retrieves all published and active vacancies.

methods.name: isActiveJobTitle
methods.description: Verifies if a job title ID corresponds to an active job title.

methods.name: isActiveHiringManger
methods.description: Checks if a hiring manager employee ID is active.
